description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT over the bioactivity rows chembl_get_bioactivities staged on a canvas — rank, group, dedupe, and aggregate across the FULL set, not the inline preview. Reference each staged table by the name chembl_get_bioactivities returned — bioactivities for its potency_ranked view, bioactivities_null_potency for null_potency; discover the staged tables and their columns with chembl_dataframe_describe. Compute honest aggregates here (e.g. SELECT parent_molecule_chembl_id, MEDIAN(pchembl_value) AS med FROM bioactivities WHERE standard_type = 'IC50' AND potential_duplicate IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, which merges a drug with its salts and drops likely repeat citations). Every row the SQL returns comes back on both structuredContent and content[], so bound the result in the SQL itself: project only the columns you need and set a LIMIT. truncated is true when the result exceeded the canvas row cap; page past it with ORDER BY a unique column (e.g. activity_id) and LIMIT/OFFSET written into the query, in place of any LIMIT it already has — offsets reach rows beyond the cap. Unavailable when the server sets CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by chembl_get_bioactivities — non-null whenever that call staged a table.

sql.description: A read-only SELECT against the staged tables. Reference tables by the names chembl_get_bioactivities returned.

name: chembl_dataframe_query

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: The server runs with the canvas off (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none), so no canvas exists. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

row_count.description: Number of rows materialized in this response.

rows.description: Result rows (capped at the canvas row limit). Each row is a column→value map.

truncated.description: True when the SQL result exceeded the canvas row cap, so rows is a bounded slice of the result set. Page past it with ORDER BY a unique column (e.g. activity_id) and LIMIT/OFFSET written into the query.
